summary: CarParts.com, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose receipt of a notice from Nasdaq that it has regained compliance with the minimum bid price rule (Listing Rule 5450(a)(1)). The Staff confirmed that the closing bid price of the common stock was $1.00 or higher for 10 consecutive business days from May 26 through June 8, 2026. No transaction, shareholder action, or strategic event is involved. This is a routine compliance update, not a special situation.
